hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path" <<< "$(cat)"); for p in ".env" "schema.d.ts" "compose.override" "vendor/" "node_modules/" ".claude/settings.json" ".claude/settings.local.json"; do if [[ "$FILE" == *"$p"* ]]; then echo "Fichier protégé: $p" >&2; exit 2; fi; done; exit 0'

bash -c 'FILE=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path" <<< "$(cat)"); if [[ "$FILE" == *"/.claude/worktrees/"* ]]; then exit 0; fi; REL="${FILE#"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/}"; if [[ "$FILE" == *.php ]]; then make -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" php-cs-fixer -- "$REL" --quiet 2>/dev/null; make -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rector -- "$REL" --quiet 2>/dev/null; elif [[ "$FILE" == *.ts || "$FILE" == *.tsx ]]; then make -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" prettier -- --write --ignore-unknown "$REL" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0'
